Package io.github.pimak.ntfy.core

Class NtfyPublisher

java.lang.Object
io.github.pimak.ntfy.core.NtfyPublisher
public class NtfyPublisher extends Object
Stateless, never-throws HTTP publisher for the ntfy wire format.

Zero framework dependencies — this class is plain-constructed by AlertEngine/ NtfyClient, not managed by any DI container. It never calls an SLF4J logger and never posts to a Logback StatusManager; the caller owns all diagnostics and only consumes the returned PublishResult.

Internal transport. This class is public only because AlertEngine, NtfyClient and StartupSelfTest needed it before there was anywhere better to put it — not because it was designed as an entry point. It is NOT covered by this library's binary-compatibility guarantee, its shape is free to change within 2.x, and it is scheduled to stop being public in 3.0. Publish through NtfyClient instead, which is the supported surface for sending a notification of your own.

What NtfyClient does not replace. An NtfyClient publishes to the destination fixed in its NtfyConfig at construction, which covers every caller that has one destination — the ordinary case. It does not cover publishing to a url/topic that varies from call to call, one per tenant or one per environment, for which the deprecated overloads below are currently the only route. That case has no supported replacement, and 3.0 removes the overloads. If you depend on it, please open an issue saying so: what replaces it has not been designed yet, and a stated use case is what would decide its shape.

No SSRF guard is included here — that concern is out of scope for a plain HTTP publisher and is the consumer's responsibility if the target URL is derived from untrusted input. The topic, however, IS validated (ntfy's own [-_A-Za-z0-9]{1,64} rule): it is concatenated into the request path, and a topic containing /, ?, #, or .. would otherwise rewrite the request target (cross-topic publishing with the configured credential).

    • publish

      @Deprecated(since="2.1.0") public PublishResult publish(String url, String topic, String title, AuthMode auth, String body, String priority, String tags, String click, String actions)
      Deprecated.
      internal transport, not covered by this library's binary-compatibility guarantee and not public in 3.0. Publish through NtfyClient, whose destination is fixed at construction; publishing to a url/topic that varies per call has no supported replacement — see the class documentation.
      Publishes title/body to {url}/{topic}, additionally forwarding priority, tags, click and actions as ntfy's Priority, Tags, Click and Actions HTTP headers. click is the URL ntfy opens when the notification is tapped; actions is a pre-serialized ntfy Actions header value (see NtfyActionSerializer).

      A blank/null value for any of priority/tags/click/actions sends no corresponding header. Values containing non-printable-ASCII characters are omitted rather than forwarded: the CRLF-injection guard must not depend solely on the JDK client's header validation, and a single invalid configured value must not abort every publish at the header-build boundary.

      The Authorization header (if any) comes entirely from the supplied AuthMode: auth.buildHeader() returns the header value to send, or Optional.empty() to send no Authorization header at all (a valid anonymous publish).

      Returns:
      a PublishResult describing the outcome; never throws
